import sys
import heapq

def dijkstra(graph, start, end, k, types):
    n = len(graph)
    pq = [(0, start, set())]
    visited = [False] * n
    while pq:
        max_crowd, node, seen_types = heapq.heappop(pq)
        if visited[node]:
            continue
        visited[node] = True
        seen_types.add(types[node])
        if node == end and len(seen_types) >= k:
            return max_crowd
        for neighbor, crowd in graph[node]:
            if not visited[neighbor]:
                new_seen_types = seen_types.copy()
                new_seen_types.add(types[neighbor])
                if len(new_seen_types) >= k:
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (max(max_crowd, crowd), neighbor, new_seen_types))
    return -1
